newsitem.title: USA: Los Angeles Cty to sell $80 mln of COPs in Nov.
newsitem.headline: Los Angeles Cty to sell $80 mln of COPs in Nov.

text.p: Los Angeles County, Calif., plans to sell $80 million of certificates of participation in Novemebr to fund court house improvements, a county oficial said Thursday.

Maureen Sicotte, the county's director of finance and investments, told a Bond Buyer California municipal finance conference here that the county was also planning to issue up to $400 million of general obligation bonds to help cover retrofit of a medical center. That GO bond issue is expected by the end of the fiscal year, June 30, 1997.
Separately, Sicotte, speaking on a panel about municipal investors, said Los Angeles County plans to use bond insurance on future financings.
"We'll continue to get insurance as long as it saves money," Sicotte said.
She was responding to one panelist saying that some investors see the municipal market as quiet because bond insurance has become so prevalent and spreads have tightened.
